name: recipe-research
description: Research a dish with parallel subagents (classic recipes, food science, pro-chef technique) and synthesize a restaurant-level recipe into a linked note tree — Obsidian vault optional.

outputDir.title: Recipe output folder
outputDir.description: Where dish folders get written, e.g. ~/recipes.

vaultMode.title: Obsidian vault mode
vaultMode.description: On: [[wiki-links]] and frontmatter tags for an Obsidian vault. Off (default): plain relative Markdown links, readable anywhere.

language.title: Output language
language.description: Language for the synthesized recipe and summaries (e.g. english, hebrew, spanish). "auto" (default) matches the language you write in.
